publications.title: Potential Benefits of Nobiletin, A Citrus Flavonoid, against Alzheimer's Disease and Parkinson's Disease.
publications.main_finding: Nobiletin improved cognitive deficits and the pathological features of Alzheimer's disease, as well as motor and cognitive deficits in Parkinson's disease animal models.
publications.limitations: The abstract does not report results from human clinical trials.

publications.title: FGF21 confers neuroprotection in Parkinson's disease by activating the FGFR1-sirt1 pathway.
publications.main_finding: FGF21 exerts multi-faceted protection in Parkinson's disease via the FGFR1-Sirt1 axis, including blood-brain barrier repair and mitochondrial homeostasis restoration.
publications.limitations: The study relies on mouse models and in vitro microglia stimulation rather than human subjects.

publications.title: Neuroprotection by dihydrotestosterone in LPS-induced neuroinflammation.
publications.main_finding: Dihydrotestosterone exerts anti-neuroinflammatory and neuroprotective effects by suppressing TLR4-mediated NF-κB and MAPK signaling pathways.
publications.limitations: The study does not provide clinical evidence in human subjects.

publications.title: Neuroprotection by saponins.
publications.main_finding: Saponins have significant neuroprotective effects on the attenuation of central nervous system disorders, such as stroke, Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and Huntington's disease.
publications.limitations: The mechanisms underlying the observed effects remain incomplete.

publications.title: Asiaticoside exerts neuroprotection through targeting NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
publications.main_finding: Asiaticoside alleviates Parkinson's disease symptoms induced by MPTP by binding to the NLRP3 protein and inhibiting inflammasome assembly.
publications.limitations: The study does not provide evidence of efficacy in human Parkinson's disease patients.

publications.title: Design, synthesis and anti-Alzheimer's disease activity evaluation of C-3 arylated huperzine A derivatives.
publications.main_finding: C-3 arylated huperzine A derivatives exhibited dual inhibitory activity against acetylcholinesterase and butyrylcholinesterase, but showed poor performance in cytotoxicity and neuroprotection assays.
publications.limitations: The derivatives failed to demonstrate effective neuroprotection in the conducted assays.

publications.title: Microbiota-Derived Tryptophan Metabolite Indole-3-Propionic Acid-Emerging Role in Neuroprotection.
publications.main_finding: Indole-3-propionic acid acts as a free radical scavenger, anti-inflammatory molecule, and ligand for AhR and PXR receptors, supporting its potential neuroprotective role.
publications.limitations: Clinical trials are still required to evaluate its therapeutic use in humans.
